experiments.trigger: Every size–f condition whose E0 heading cosine remains above0.8 at the longest usable lag.
experiments.gate: Trigger inventory from E0; execution after E1/E2. All finite horizons/censoring remain explicit.

A1.heading_autocorrelation: Full scalar cadence, lags one cadence through half the analysis window. Require both endpointR>=0.1; report per-lag usable-pair coverage.
A1.uncertainty: 2000 whole-seed bootstrap resamples; never frame bootstrap.
A1.tau_p: First lag with C=1/e; lower bound if not reached, unresolved below two cadence steps.
A1.angular_diffusivity: Initial unwrapped-heading MSD slope over2–10 cadence steps; do not bridge undefined headings without a declared method.

A2.persistence_ratio: tau_p(largest)/tau_p(smallest), bootstrapCI; Dtheta(small)/Dtheta(large) alternative when tau censored.
A2.noise_tolerance: fhalf where tau_p falls to half weakest-input value, interpolate in logf, withCI and censoring/unavailability.

A3.site: Heading angle times actualC/(2pi) in single-qualified-region frames; peak maximum sensitivity.
A3.physical_diffusivity: Dtheta*(actualC/(2pi))^2; retain physical-site MSD to distinguish diffusion and confinement.
A3.excess_persistence: Persistence ratio divided by geometric circumference-ratio squared; reference size ratio3 gives9. ActualSpringcircumferences must be explicit.

A4.regime: Class occupying more than50% of second-half time, otherwise mixed; verify mutually exclusive treatment against existing descriptor definitions.
A4.primary_forced_state: Matched-mean control more than50% of secondhalf withR<0.1 or lowcontrast.
A4.E1_forced_state: Also record evidence that the abnormal regime persists as sigma approaches0; declare operational rule before analysis.
